name: Config tampering → remote code execution
impact: An attacker who can write a config file gets arbitrary code execution when the app loads it.
narrative: The path-traversal flaw lets an attacker drop a crafted file where the app will read it; the unsafe deserialization (or eval) of that file then executes attacker-controlled code.

name: SQL injection → credential theft → lateral movement
impact: Database contents and the credentials stored alongside them are exfiltrated and reused against other systems.
narrative: The injectable query dumps stored credentials; because they are protected by weak crypto or travel over an unverified channel, the attacker recovers them in usable form and pivots to adjacent services.
